notes: MastersPortal blocks server-side crawlers. Each seed uses the MastersPortal detail page as sourceUrl and the provider website as applicationUrl. Imports land as needs_review unless --status=verified.

scholarships.title: Studyportals Scholarship — €10,000 Master's Abroad
scholarships.description: The Studyportals Scholarship awards €10,000 toward a Master's degree abroad at a Studyportals partner university. Open to students worldwide, including Ethiopia. Applicants must be accepted to a partner university, complete the motivation letter step, and apply via the official Studyportals Typeform before the deadline.

scholarships.title: Fully Funded DAAD EPOS Scholarship
scholarships.description: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS) fund graduates from developing countries, including Ethiopia, for Master's study at German universities. Benefits include monthly stipend, insurance, and travel allowance. Requires a Bachelor's degree, at least two years of professional experience, and application via the official DAAD scholarship database.

scholarships.title: ServiceScape Scholarship
scholarships.description: The ServiceScape Scholarship awards $1,000 toward educational expenses for students enrolled or planning to enroll in an accredited college, university, or trade school. Applicants submit a short essay on how writing impacts today's world. Open to international students aged 18 or older.

scholarships.title: Queen Elizabeth Commonwealth Scholarships
scholarships.description: Queen Elizabeth Commonwealth Scholarships offer fully funded two-year Master's study in low or middle-income Commonwealth countries. Aimed at students committed to creating change in their communities. Covers tuition, living allowance, return travel, and research support where approved.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: The JJ/WBGSP supports citizens of developing countries with professional experience who are applying to development-related Master's programmes. Benefits include tuition, economy travel, medical insurance, and a monthly subsistence allowance for study outside the applicant's home country.

scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters scholarships
scholarships.amount: Participation costs plus travel and living allowance
scholarships.description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are integrated international Master's programmes delivered by university consortia across Europe and partner countries. Top-ranked applicants worldwide may receive EU-funded scholarships covering participation costs, travel, visa, and a living allowance.

scholarships.title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme
scholarships.description: Stipendium Hungaricum offers tuition-free Master's study in Hungary with a monthly stipend, dormitory place or housing allowance, and medical insurance. Applicants register on the official portal, choose up to two programmes, and apply through their sending partner in their home country.

scholarships.title: Scholarship for Christian Young People
scholarships.description: The Scholarship Programme for Christian Young People supports students from crisis regions facing religious persecution to pursue higher education in Hungary. Applicants need a church recommendation letter and apply through the official SCYP portal during the published call window.

scholarships.title: Women Scholarship for International Students
scholarships.description: educations.com awards up to $5,000 to female international students beginning undergraduate, graduate, or post-graduate study abroad in Fall 2026 or Spring 2027. Applicants complete the official online form on educations.com and must plan to study outside their home country.

scholarships.title: Voice Talent Online Scholarship
scholarships.description: Voice Talent Online invites enrolled university students worldwide to compete for a $1,000 scholarship by writing and publishing a blog article on one of the listed themes. Entries must follow the provider's formatting rules and include the required hyperlink in the post.

scholarships.title: Mundus MAPP EMJM Scholarship
scholarships.description: Mundus MAPP is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Public Policy delivered by CEU, IBEI, ISS, and the University of York. Outstanding applicants worldwide may receive an EMJM scholarship covering tuition and a monthly contribution toward travel and living costs when selected through the official CEU application portal.

scholarships.title: CryptoRunner Scholarship
scholarships.description: CryptoRunner awards $500 annually to a student writing a Master's thesis or studying abroad with an economics or finance angle. Applicants email their application with academic details, a short personal presentation, and a thesis or study-abroad summary before 31 October.
